title: Replacement Card Charges on the Pocketwire Visa Debit Card: Rule and Casebook
content:
**Rule.** Pocketwire Visa Debit Card replacement charges depend on why the card was blocked.

- **Stolen or compromised.** A replacement for a card blocked as stolen or compromised is free. It ships expedited at no charge on tiers where stolen or compromised replacements ship expedited free.
- **Lost or damaged.** A replacement for a card blocked as lost or damaged is free while the customer's paid-reason replacements over the rolling 365 days are fewer than the tier's free replacements. Paid-reason replacements are the customer's cards issued as replacements for a lost or damaged card with an issue date in the 365 days ending on the new card's issue date, not counting the card being issued. Beyond the free allowance, the replacement card fee is charged on the issue date. When the replacement falls inside the allowance, the replacement card fee is still booked, with an amount of 0.00.
- **Tier and number.** A replacement is issued on the same tier as the blocked card, unless the linked plan no longer allows that tier. The new card has a new number, and the blocked card's number never works again.
- **Card that never arrived.** Replacement and shipping fees are refunded only when Pocketwire shipped a card that never arrived, and the customer reports this within the standard or expedited delivery time plus 5 business days. In that case the replacement for the missing card is free.

### Casebook (hypothetical cases)

**Case 1: first lost card of the year.** A card on a tier with one free replacement is blocked as lost. The customer has no lost or damaged replacement issued in the 365 days ending on the new issue date. Zero is fewer than one, so the replacement is free, and the replacement card fee is booked at 0.00.

**Case 2: second lost card.** The same customer loses the replacement a few months later. There is now one lost or damaged replacement in the 365-day window, and one is not fewer than one. The tier's replacement card fee is charged on the new issue date.

**Case 3: stolen card after two lost cards.** The customer's card is then stolen. A stolen replacement is free whatever the count of lost or damaged replacements, and it does not add to that count. Whether it ships expedited at no charge depends on the tier's setting.

**Case 4: undelivered card.** A physical card sent by standard delivery, on a tier whose standard delivery time is 10 business days, never arrives. The customer reports it within 15 business days after the issue date, that is 10 plus 5. The replacement and shipping fees are refunded, and the replacement for the missing card is free. A report after that period does not meet this refund condition.

| Block reason | Paid-reason replacements in the 365 days | Replacement card fee |
|---|---|---|
| stolen or compromised | any number | free |
| lost or damaged | fewer than the tier's free replacements | booked at 0.00 |
| lost or damaged | equal to or more than the tier's free replacements | the tier's replacement card fee |
